nodes.label: UTF-8 Replacement-Character Corruption (U+FFFD)
nodes.rationale: icon-96x96.png is not a valid decodable PNG. Binary analysis: the file (11,431 bytes) carries a 3-byte UTF-8-encoded U+FFFD prefix (EF BF BD) before the PNG signature, and 2,597 U+FFFD triplets (~68.2% of bytes) scattered through the body, including the IHDR CRC and IDAT payload. This pattern is the signature of a lossy UTF-8 text round-trip (decode with errors='replace', then re-encode), i.e. the binary was processed as text by some pipeline/tool and irreversibly destroyed. The surviving IHDR header declares a 96x96 8-bit RGBA image; by naming and location it is the PWA/site icon of this HAXcms site, one of the assets icon-48/72/96/144/192/256/512, favicon.png, favicon.ico. The image could not be rendered or visually inspected; only the corruption and declared geometry are certain. Likely cause: the icon was accidentally edited/committed through a text-based tool; it should be re-exported from source and re-committed.
